name: Zalik et al. Algorithm
definition: A code-based traversal algorithm that solves the problem of standard Bresenham missing cells by using two phases: first determining cells via Bresenham, then examining relationships between successive cells to find remaining ones.
summary: The Zalik et al. algorithm is a voxel traversal method that corrects standard 3D Bresenham tracing by adding a post-processing phase to recover missed cells, ensuring topological completeness.
